s.note: the jungle home George shares with Ape
s.how: Mash 3 ripe bananas with 150g brown sugar, 100g melted butter, 2 eggs and a teaspoon of cinnamon. Fold in 250g self-raising flour until just combined. Pour into a lined loaf tin and bake at 175C for 55 minutes. Cool a little, then slice thick and butter.

Peel and cube 2 mangoes, half a pineapple and half a papaya and tip into a big bowl. Scoop over the pulp of 3 passionfruit. Squeeze over the juice of 2 limes and toss gently with torn mint leaves. Chill for 20 minutes before serving.

m.how: Soften sliced fennel and garlic in olive oil, then add a can of crushed tomatoes and 250ml white wine and simmer for 20 minutes. Add 400g chunks of white fish, 300g green prawns and 500g mussels, cover and cook 6 minutes until the mussels open. Serve with toasted sourdough.

w.note: the trees George keeps swinging into
w.how: Simmer 150g arborio rice in 800ml coconut milk with 80g sugar and a teaspoon of vanilla paste for 30 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy. Chill for 2 hours. Spoon into bowls and top with toasted shredded coconut and slices of fresh mango.

d.how: Peel 2 bananas and a mango and drop into a blender. Add 300g Greek yoghurt, 2 tbsp honey and a big handful of ice. Blend until thick and smooth, adding a splash of water if it is too thick, then pour into tall glasses with straws.
